decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp from Stripe to Coinbase Commerce does not change the independently selected Brevo transactional email provider.
The fiat on-ramp provider change does not alter the $5 automatic referral commission.
The provider switch does not change email-based dashboard access for fiat users or its authentication method.
The fiat on-ramp provider has no necessary effect on unauthenticated public API access.
Publishing prize-pool values through public APIs remains unchanged by the fiat on-ramp provider switch.
SIWE authentication for crypto minting and transfers remains valid independently of the fiat on-ramp provider.
Changing the fiat on-ramp provider does not alter ticket allocation following a successful no-referral mint.
Changing the fiat on-ramp provider does not alter prize-ticket issuance for successful referral-code mints.
